design_constraints: Reuse src/mgk kernel as the authority core (no weakening of v0.1.0 behavior).
No new runtime dependencies: stdlib http.server, sqlite3, fcntl only.
Closed actuator registry: sandbox.read_file, sandbox.write_file, sandbox.append_file, sandbox.create_record, sandbox.read_record. No shell/network/arbitrary-fs actuators.
PROPOSAL IS NOT AUTHORITY: no governed side effect without a valid, scoped, single-use capability issued by the kernel authority.
Decision states: ALLOW, DENY, REQUIRE_HUMAN, INDETERMINATE (fail-closed => no side effect).
Capability binds: request_id (request_digest), action (scope), resource (scope+resource_binding), constraints (TTL), issued_at, expires_at, nonce (single-use), authorization_epoch.
Human gate decisions are signed by an operator key and recorded in the ledger.
Secrets (authority/audit/operator private keys) are runtime-generated in a gitignored workspace; never committed.
No eval/exec of untrusted content; proposals are data-only.

kernel_reuse.authority: CapabilityAuthority.issue (SAXP-gated mintage; extended additively for sandbox action bindings)
kernel_reuse.verifier: CapabilityVerifier.verify (strict canonical, epoch, nonce, scope; extended additively for sandbox binding shapes)
kernel_reuse.executor: CapabilityExecutor.execute (extended additively to dispatch the 5 sandbox actuators)
kernel_reuse.crypto: Ed25519 domain-separated (unchanged); new HUMAN_GATE_DOMAIN for operator decisions

modules.runtime/config.py: RuntimeConfig (workdir, port, mode, sensitive actions, context policy)
modules.runtime/workspace.py: workspace initialization: keys, dirs, seed files
modules.runtime/policy.py: RuntimePolicy: allow_safe / deny_all mode + sensitive-action -> REQUIRE_HUMAN context provider
modules.runtime/human_gate.py: HumanGate: pending queue, signed APPROVE/DENY, persistence
modules.runtime/flight.py: FlightRecorder: append-only hash-chained JSONL of runtime events + checkpoint + integrity verify
modules.runtime/runtime_ledger.py: RuntimeLedger: proposals, decisions, capabilities, human actions (SQLite or derived from flight)
modules.runtime/web.py: stdlib http.server app: status, propose form, decision view, human gate, flight recorder, evidence
modules.runtime/sandbox/actions.py: ACTUATOR registry: read_file, write_file, append_file, create_record, read_record

cli.new: mgk start|stop|status|doctor|test (added to src/mgk/cli.py additively, lazy imports of runtime)

web_routes.GET /evidence: evidence view HTML (ledger integrity, capabilities, audit)

sandbox.write_file.binding: write {path, pre_state present|absent, pre_sha256, pre_size, post_sha256, post_size}
sandbox.write_file.execute: verify pre-state unchanged -> create (O_EXCL) or truncate+write -> fsync -> verify post-state

sandbox.append_file.binding: append {path, pre_sha256, pre_size, append_sha256, append_size, post_sha256, post_size}
sandbox.append_file.execute: verify pre-state -> append at descriptor -> fsync -> verify post-state

sandbox.create_record.execute: validate canonical JSON content -> create_bound (O_EXCL) -> rollback on audit failure

propose: NON_TEN_XEITO -> DENY (no capability, no effect); flight + audit record
REQUIRE_XEITO -> REQUIRE_HUMAN (enqueue pending, no capability); flight + audit record
issue fails -> DENY; issue succeeds -> executor.execute(envelope, request)
executor success -> ALLOW (output/effect recorded); executor denial -> DENY
any unexpected exception / integrity failure -> INDETERMINATE -> fail-closed DENY, no side effect
human_gate: operator reviews pending proposal (proposal data is data-only)
APPROVE: sign human decision (HUMAN_GATE_DOMAIN, operator key) -> re-issue capability for the SAME request_digest -> execute -> record
DENY: sign human decision -> record denial, discard proposal
human decision appended to flight recorder + runtime ledger

integrity_model.flight_recorder: hash-chained JSONL with verified checkpoint (mgk doctor verifies)
integrity_model.runtime_ledger: rows mirror flight events; integrity re-verifiable from flight
integrity_model.doctor: verify root-of-trust anchor, key presence, state integrity, ledger + flight integrity, sandbox confinement probe, h14-smoke

security_controls: authorization_epoch checked at mintage, verify, and pre-commit
resource binding revalidated at point of use (anti-TOCTOU)
human gate signed and bound to proposal digest
no secrets committed; keys runtime-generated + gitignored
CSRF-safe: state-changing API requires explicit JSON body + Content-Type; loopback-only origin
